literal_meaning: তল্পির বাহক বা বহনকারী (satchel or bag carrier)
figurative_meaning_en: Follower or a person who blindly obeys orders, often implying a sycophant or lackey
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার নেতার তল্পিবাহকের মতো সবকিছুতে সমর্থন করে।
আমি কারো তল্পিবাহক হয়ে থাকতে চাই না।
example_sentences_in_english: He supports everything like a lackey to his leader.
I don't want to be anyone's yes-man.
history: The idiom derives from historical practices where disciples or followers carried the 'talpi' (a type of satchel or bag) of their guru or leader, symbolizing unwavering loyalty and service.
note: Often used derogatorily to criticize blind allegiance.
